text:
Omar (AE): Heads-up — customer sent a fully redlined SOW asking for MFN + 12mo price protection + a hard cap on price increases. Need pricing impact and deal-desk guidance.

Elaine (AM): Which customer and what's the ask on commit/tier?

Omar (AE): Acme Health. Pilot -> aiming Dedicated. They proposed 12mo commit at ~$50k/mo. MFN language is broad — they want us to match any lower price they get later (no carveouts).

Mike (SE): MFN + price-protection + caps = big operational risk. If we run any promo later, MFN could trigger retro credits. :eyes:

Jessie (Legal): Paste of customer's clause: "Customer shall be entitled to most favored customer pricing (MFN) for duration of contract and 12 months thereafter." We don't accept open MFN. Typical counter is scoped MFN (same product/SKU/region/entity) and carve out promos/partner/channel pricing.

Elaine (AM): Need a quick dollar calc for deal desk. If commit = $600k ARR and promo later 20% lower, exposure ~= $120k in credits.

Mike (SE): Quick rate-card snippet for context:
```
standard-hosted: $0.03/token
dedicated-small: $40,000/mo
dedicated-medium: $80,000/mo
```
If we allow 10% downward price protection, monthly rev delta = `0.1 * commit`.

Omar (AE): Deal desk — can we approve MFN limited to same product & legal entity, exclude marketplace and time-limited promos, and cap cumulative credits at 15%? Also propose price-protection window = 12 months. @Deal Desk

dealbot: Approval request created: DD-4591 — status: pending.

Deal Desk (Renewals): Finance needs visibility. Recommended counter: MFN limited to identical SKU and purchasing channel; exclude public promotions, channel/partner discounts, and marketplace offers; price-protection for 12 months post-signature; cap cumulative credits at 15% of committed fees; require minimum committed usage and no retro credits beyond 30 days after notification. We'll need finance sign-off for the cap percentage.

Jessie (Legal): I can draft redline with those carveouts: MFN scoped to same product SKU and legal entity, price-protection applies only to published list prices, exclude marketplace/promos, cap cumulative credit at 15% of committed fees.

Elaine (AM): Sounds reasonable. Omar — any objection from the customer historically to carveouts like that?

Omar (AE): They pushed on MFN during preliminary commercial discussion but seemed ok with scoped language. Will raise on EOD call; POC still ongoing so they want to avoid blocking close.

Katie (CSM): Operational note — if we accept any MFN-like clause, we should add a 12mo pricing-monitoring runbook to flag changes and trigger account review.

Deal Desk (Renewals): If we greenlight this approach, we'll attach the amendment template and run the exposure calc. Finance estimate: worst-case if we later offer a 20% promo across the committed term ~ $120k exposure on this commit. Please confirm before legal finalizes.

Jessie (Legal): I'll prepare draft and put redline in the workspace. Tagging @dealbot to keep the approval request open.

Elaine (AM): Great. @Jessie (Legal) please send the draft. @dealbot keep DD-4591 pending until finance signs off. :thumbsup:

Omar (AE): I'll escalate on the call and update thread after the customer meeting.

Mike (SE): Also flag product team if the customer asks for SLA tweaks — uptime caps + financial remedies require engineering sign-off.

Omar (AE): Noted. Will loop in eng if they push SLA credits.

Katie (CSM): Adding a note to the account plan to track pricing exposure for 12 months post-close.

Elaine (AM): Thanks team — keep updates brief here.
